Features

Mastery (Sap)

If you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack using this staff, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

Spell Core Gauge

You awaken its internal Spell Core, allowing you to siphon magical energy from your enemies to empower your own spells. The staff can hold a maximum of 3 Spell Counters. It loses all counters when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

▸ Upgrade — Expanded Gauge

The staff can now hold a maximum of 5 Spell Counters.

▸ Upgrade — Expanded Gauge Upgrade I

The staff can now hold a maximum of 7 Spell Counters.

▸ Upgrade — Expanded Gauge Upgrade II

The staff can now hold a maximum of 10 Spell Counters.

Harvest Magic

When you deal damage to a hostile creature with a Cantrip, the staff absorbs residual magic and gains 1 Spell Counter. If the target of your Cantrip is within 15 feet of you, the staff absorbs energy faster, gaining 2 Spell Counters instead.

Arcane Discharge

When you cast a leveled spell with a duration of Instantaneous that deals damage, you can expend any number of Spell Counters from the staff. For each counter expended, one target affected by the spell takes an extra [[/r 1d6]] damage of the spell's type.

▸ Upgrade — Discharge Upgrade I

The extra damage from your Arcane Discharge increases to [[/r 1d8]] per counter.

▸ Upgrade — Discharge Upgrade II

The extra damage from your Arcane Discharge increases to [[/r 1d10]] per counter and the entire spell ignores Resistance to its damage type.

Improve Casting

You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DCs while holding this magic weapon.

▸ Upgrade — Improve Casting Upgrade I

You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DCs while holding this magic weapon.

▸ Upgrade — Improve Casting Upgrade II

You gain a +3 bonus to Spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DCs while holding this magic weapon.

Offset Ward

Reaction.

You learn to parry attacks using raw magical discharge. As a Reaction when you are hit by a melee attack, you can expend 2 Spell Counters to project a brief, intense barrier, granting you a +5 bonus to your AC against that attack. If this causes the attack to miss, you can immediately cast a Cantrip spell-attack with a casting time of 1 Action targeting the attacker as part of the same Reaction.

Zero Sum Spell

Action.

You can overload the Spell Core for a devastating close-range blast. As an Action, you can expend all remaining Spell Counters in the staff (minimum of 3 counters required) to make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes [[/r 1d12]] Force damage for each counter expended, and is pushed 15 feet away from you. On a miss, the energy dissipates harmlessly. In both cases, the staff drops to 0 counters.
